mapper.select: select f.target_type, f.target_id, e.title, e.poster_image, e.start_date, e.end_date, e.price, f.create_time as favorite_time, g.name as gallery_name from favorite f join exhibition e on e.id = f.target_id join gallery g on g.id = e.gallery_id where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.target_type = 1 order by f.create_time desc, f.id desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

select f.target_type, f.target_id, g.name, g.cover_image, g.address, g.exhibition_count, f.create_time as favorite_time from favorite f join gallery g on g.id = f.target_id where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.target_type = 2 order by f.create_time desc, f.id desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
